notes.title: FULL RELEASE
notes.notes:
We are glad to release The Last Man Survivor in full access today! 
What's in the game right now:

[list]
[*] 3 maps with a plot and difficulty modifiers for them
[*] 50 types of hand-drawn opponents
[*] 9 unique characters
[*] Lots unique equipment and magic potions
[*] 33 quest tasks
[/list]
[b]We hope you will have a lot of fun with our game![/b]

[h2]Hotfix April 24[/h2]
[list]
[*] Crit vampirism and passive regeneration no longer prevent you from completing the "Survive without restoring health" quest
[*] Fixed a bug with quest achievement with the release of 25 goblins
[*] Fixed a bug in displaying the maximum value of the passive regeneration meta boost
[*] Fixed minor visual bugs
[/list]

notes.title: January'25 Minor Update
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Changed the price for rare items delivery, now it doesn't cost crystals but needs to be unlocked by achievement "Release 10/25 goblins from the cage"
[*] Lilith "endless game" bug fixed
[*] Game build size optimization
[*] Now you can see your bought and future meta progression
[*] Added loading wheel
[/list]

notes.title: Winter'25 Update
notes.notes:
Today's update consists of modifiers. You may get new achievements by completing maps and getting curse points

[h3]Curse of the Elders[/h3]
x3 Bosses. Experience gain is reduced by 2 times
[h3]Curse of the Horde[/h3]
x2 enemy speed. x1.5 number of enemies (except Bosses)
[h3]Curse of the Warrior[/h3]
No abilities, no potions. Only weapons
[h3]Curse of the Shadow[/h3]
The hero is chased by shadows. Their touch instantly kills


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44228118/0f965e90e632df19ffcd8180d57b4c539758fb67.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Bullet Heaven Fest 2.0
notes.notes: We are glad to announce about taking part in Bullet Heaven Fest 2.0 on the 4th of December with our newcomer The Last Man Survivor!

notes.title: EARLY ACCESS IS AVAILABLE NOW
notes.notes:
[b]Hello Survivors![/b]
We are ready to step on the path of Early Access, destroy hordes of enemies and try to SURVIVE!
Also, we are waiting for your feedback, please tell us about all the bugs, we'll fix them as soon as possible

[h3]Hot Fix - 24 Oct 2024[/h3]
[list]
[*] Magic Potion duration increased from 30 to 60 seconds
[*] Fixed stacking in the dungeon of the 2nd map
[*] Portal marker is now more notable
[*] Fixed formatting of the names of item descriptions at a non-standard resolution
[/list]
[h3]Hot Fix - 25 Oct 2024[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added "Best quality" option, turn it off for better performance. Press ESC during session to see it
[*] Potion activation by gamepad left stick doesn't work anymore
[*] Wide resolution optimization
[*] Fixed "double highlight" of some buttons
[*] Added option to report a bug in Chinese translation, clicking it directs you to the Discord server
[/list]
[h3]Hot Fix - 27 Oct 2024[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed bug when game picks wrong level up, no the one that you've chosen
[*] Fixed bug that allowed to upgrade blocked meta-builds
[*] Fixed a bug when Black Holes didn't appear and covered heroes and mobs
[*] Decreased attack range of Werewolves and Trolls
[*] FIxed the description of the Forester's shoes
[*] Fixed The Fool's Amulet and The Amulet of the Eternal Charon
[*] Logo sound volume decreased
[/list]
[h3]Hot Fix - 06 Nov 2024[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added window mode option
[*] Chinese translation is correct now
[*] Fixed a critical bug that occurs when leveling up in late game
[*] Added a hint of the gamepad button to close the modals in the main menu
[/list]
[h3]Hot Fix - 20 Nov 2024[/h3]
Rebalanced Necromancer 
Rebalanced hard mod of the map “Hot sands” 
Fixed experience disappearing from the surface when exiting the dungeon
Changed the description of the improvement of the Agony branch of the Fire Wall skill
Removed buttons-links to discord and wishlist

[b]If you see any mistranslations in other languages, please tell us via Discord[/b]

notes.title: EARLY ACCESS RELEASE DATE: OCTOBER 24
notes.notes:
[b]Hello Survivors![/b]

We are finally ready to announce the exact date of release - 24th of October
What's coming? - New map and three new Survivors, different kinds of equipment, fresh potions and a lot of other stuff! Oh, yeah, almost forgot about the continuation of the story of the Last Survivor! Stay tuned!
